text: this is good. now give me a smoothing/leveling tool so i can smooth out these sorts of things into one clean mesh [Image #1] but u can see here it works pretty good [Image #2]
resolution: Added a height smooth/level tool to hmsc-int. It appears as a new Smooth height mode with a strength control, persists smoothStrength in brush settings, and stamps the heightfield by fitting a local best-fit plane under the brush footprint so it removes spikes/ridges while preserving broad ramps. Added focused heightData tests for plane preservation and spike leveling, then verified with fast hmsc-int ship build.
